name: Magical Otoge Anholly
source:
A cheerful yet hopeless girl named Anholly lives alone in her hometown of Solvalis after her uncontrollable ice powers froze it over. Her only visitors are her timid childhood friend Riov and a small white dog nicknamed HD.

That is, until one day an ice spirit named Seihuo finds Solvalis and collapses there, while on a journey to find his way back home.

Seihuo, who chooses to be alone, and Anholly, who is alone against her will, form a special bond in the time they're together.

And watching from afar is a mysterious figure named Veltaire...

[From [url=https://moonobservatory.uwu.ai/#anholly]official website[/url]]
translation:
名叫安荷莉的女孩開朗卻走投無路。由於失控的冰之力量，她的故鄉索爾瓦利斯被冰封，如今她獨自生活在那裡。唯一來訪的人，是膽怯的青梅竹馬里奧夫，以及一隻暱稱為HD的小白狗。

直到某天，一位叫作塞福的冰之精靈來到索爾瓦利斯，並在那裡倒下。他正在旅途中，尋找回家的路。

選擇獨處的塞福，與違背意願孤身一人的安荷莉，在相處中建立起特殊的羈絆。

而遠處，還有一個名叫維爾泰爾的神秘身影注視著一切……

[來自 [url=https://moonobservatory.uwu.ai/#anholly]官方網站[/url]]
